_comment: Krea 2 LoRAs for local image generation. Copied to $DATA_DIR/image_loras.json on first use; edit that copy. kind: realism, detail, style, adult. Use at most one adult LoRA per image. strength is the default; range is what works. steps / scheduler / sampler override the Krea 2 Turbo defaults (8, simple, euler) when this LoRA is used. trigger is added to the prompt automatically.

loras.label: Realism v1
loras.notes: General photorealism: skin, light, lens character. Good default for photo portraits.

loras.label: Realistic snapshot
loras.notes: Candid phone-snapshot look: natural flash, casual framing, less polish.

loras.label: Enhancer
loras.notes: Adds fine detail and crispness; stack with a realism LoRA.

loras.label: Photo-detail slider
loras.notes: Pulls images back to photographic detail; raise towards 2 if results drift anime or plastic.

loras.label: Mystic XXX v3
loras.notes: All-in-one adult content for fictional adults. Use one adult LoRA at a time.

loras.label: SNOFS
loras.notes: All-in-one adult content for fictional adults; alternative to Mystic XXX, not with it.

loras.label: NSFW Master Turbo
loras.notes: Adult content tuned for Turbo; alternative to Mystic XXX, not with it.

loras.label: Dark brush
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: muted minimalist ink sketch.

loras.label: Sunset blur
loras.notes: Official Krea 2 style LoRA: dreamy motion blur, sunset tones.
